profile.headline: Senior Mainframe Application Developer at Charles Schwab |AI|Legacy Modernization
profile.summary: An aspiring computer professional with 13+ years of exp in the IT sector. Modernising legacy systems using AI business rule extraction from COBOL and legacy mainframe applications.Reverse engineering and intelligent documentation.AI assisted refactoring and system transformation using Copilot ,IBM Zowe,IBM ADDI, MCP.Experience in requirement gathering,system analysis,handling business and technical issues and communicating with both business and technical users.Experience in mainframes,DB2,JCL,CHGMAN,IBM DEBUG,VSAM,COBOL,FMDB2,IMSDB,IMSDC,API testing,AS400,Extensive experience in RDBMS databases DB2.Good experience in different domains as Healthcare,banking,logistics,Capital market domains.Worked on migration/modernisation projects on mainframe to Java/Cloud with REST API.Experienced in L2 support worked on Service now,Jira,confluence.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Client 1: Unicredit SPCA(Europe)
Client 2: CSX Railways(USA)
Worked on development,enhancement,production support,modernisation and migration projects.Gained knowledge in Cobol migration,Mainframe,Cobol,IMSDB,CHGMAN,IMSDC,IBM Debug,CICS,mainframe modernization,service now,HP service manager,JIRA,Db2,IMSDB,TOAD,FMDB2,IBM GRAPPA,data engineering ,HADOOP ecosystem,python,HIVE,HDFS,Sqoop,zookeeper,kafka.Worked on importing and exporting data from RDBMS to HDFS and HIVE.Worked on nosql database mongodb.Knowledge on SPARK architecture.
positions.insights: COBOL, IBM DB2 Connect and +3 skills

positions.description:
Client: Elevance Health(Anthem health insurance)
Worked as senior software developer and handled mainframes predominantly. Gained expertise in cobol, data engineering frameworks,python,Db2, IMSDB,IMSDC,FMDB2,CHGMAN. Also enhanced and worked on programs from scratch.Was involved in all phases of SDLC including requirement gathering,design,coding,testing and implementation
